content: Rifater tablets are light beige in color, smooth, round, and have a shiny sugar-coated surface. They are imprinted with the word RIFATER in black ink. Each tablet contains 120 mg of rifampin, 50 mg of isoniazid, and 300 mg of pyrazinamide. These tablets are supplied in bottles containing 60 tablets, identified by the National Drug Code (NDC) 0088-0576-41. The recommended storage conditions for Rifater tablets are at a controlled room temperature of 25°C (77°F). However, temperature excursions between 15°C and 30°C (59°F to 86°F) are permitted. It is essential to protect the tablets from excessive humidity to maintain their stability and efficacy. For reference, susceptibility testing for Mycobacteria, Nocardiae, and other aerobic actinomycetes is outlined in the Clinical Laboratory Standards Institute (CLSI) document M24-A, which was approved in 2003.
